title: Four people, one fridge
summary: Four students share a flat and need to solve the problem of the disappearing food.
paragraphs: When Sam moved into a shared flat with three other students, he was excited. He liked his new {{flatmates}}: Ana studied medicine, Karim studied engineering and Bea studied music. They got on well. There was only one problem: the fridge.

Food disappeared. Sam bought six yogurts on Monday, and by Wednesday there were two. Ana's cheese was gone. Karim's milk was always nearly finished. Bea started writing her name on everything, even the eggs. Nobody wanted to {{accuse}} anyone, so everybody just felt annoyed.

Then one night, Karim had an idea. "Let's have a meeting," he said. They sat around the kitchen table with tea and biscuits. Everyone admitted something. Sam sometimes ate Bea's chocolate. Ana used Karim's milk for her coffee. Karim had eaten Sam's yogurts at two in the morning while studying for an exam. Bea had finished Ana's cheese in a sandwich. Everyone laughed.

They made a plan. Each person would have one shelf in the fridge. One shelf would be for {{shared}} food: milk, bread, eggs and butter. Every Sunday, they would put money in a jar and one person would do the shopping for the shared shelf. They wrote the rules on a piece of paper and stuck it on the fridge door.

The plan worked. Nobody's yogurts disappeared any more. Then, on Sundays, they started cooking together too: one person chose the recipe and the others helped. By the end of the year, Sunday dinner was the best part of the week. When Bea finished her course and moved out, they gave her a present: the piece of paper with the fridge {{rules}}, in a frame.

flatmates.meaning: people who share a flat with you

accuse.meaning: say that someone has done something wrong

shared.meaning: used by more than one person

rules.meaning: instructions that say what you can and cannot do

questions.question: What was the problem in the flat?
options: Food kept disappearing from the fridge.

questions.question: What did they discover at the meeting?
options: Everyone had eaten someone else's food.
Karim was the only one taking food.
A neighbour had a key to the flat.
questions.explanation: Everyone admitted eating or using something that belonged to someone else.

questions.question: Which of these was part of their plan?
options: One shared shelf and money in a jar every Sunday
questions.explanation: They had one shared shelf and put money in a jar every Sunday.

questions.question: What did they give Bea when she moved out?
options: The paper with the fridge rules in a frame
questions.explanation: They gave her the piece of paper with the fridge rules, in a frame.
